svg.text: I757-M Board 2 — P1 field terminals: fast digital inputs HSDI0–7, RS-485 ports 5/6
View: facing the front panel, positions 1/2 at the top. Always follow the silkscreen on the board.
HSDI0/1 and HSDI4/5 share their A terminal:
join the common of both sources there.
Each input is a bridge (A/B pair):
One pair per channel: flow meter,
120 Ω at each bus end (not on board).
HSDI channels are software-configurable: level input, pulse counter (with pulse qualifier),
or quadrature encoder (HSDI0+1 on TIM3, HSDI4+5 on TIM1). See the HSDI configuration contract.
